This is the official channel of VetSurgeon.org and VetNurse.co.uk, the news and community websites for veterinary professionals to help each other. 

It contains peer-reviewed veterinary clinical demonstrations performed by specialist or experienced UK veterinary surgeons and peer-reviewed by Alasdair Hotston Moore FRCVS.

It also contains product briefings and interviews.

Films published here are also published on VetSurgeon.org and VetNurse.co.uk, where UK-based vets and nurses can claim a CPD certificate for the time spent watching.
